title: Luxury Old Town Oasis | Sleeps 12 | Pool | Daybed
description:
Welcome to the ultimate blend of luxury, comfort, and unforgettable memories. This stunning 6‑bedroom, 4‑bath retreat comfortably sleeps up to 12 guests and is perfectly designed for family vacations, bachelorette/bachelor getaways, golf trips, and group escapes—just 6 minutes from Old Town. Enjoy seamless indoor‑outdoor living with dramatic 16‑ft sliding doors, multiple lounge spaces, and a resort‑style backyard with pool, outdoor TV and daybed—ideal for relaxing or entertaining.

 The space 
THE SPACE:

A thoughtfully designed Scottsdale retreat where space, comfort, and effortless entertaining come together. This single‑level home offers refined interiors, resort‑style outdoor living, and a layout ideal for groups who value both connection and privacy.

Property Highlights:

• 6 Bedrooms | Sleeps 12 | 9 Beds
(King, Queen, 5 Full, Twin, Twin Daybed)

• Two Private Ensuite Suites

Primary suite with king bed, dual vanities, and spacious rain shower
Second suite with queen bed and private bath

• Four Full Bathrooms
Three walk‑in showers and one tub/shower combination

• Open‑Concept Living with Two Distinct Lounge Areas
Designed for conversation, relaxation, and shared experiences

• Private Resort‑Style Pool (optional heating available for $35/day for duration of stay)
Surrounded by lounge seating, umbrellas, and a signature pyramid daybed

• Indoor‑Outdoor Flow
Ideal for morning coffee, afternoon pool time, and evening gatherings

• Prime Scottsdale Location
Minutes to Old Town, dining, shopping, hiking, and golf

• Designer Backyard
Fire pit, grill, shaded dining, outdoor smart TV, and curated seating

• Art‑Forward Details
Custom desert mural creates a striking, photo‑worthy backdrop

• Fully Equipped Chef’s Kitchen
Modern appliances, large island, and complimentary coffee bar

• Family‑Friendly Conveniences
Pack ’n Play, highchair, children’s tableware, books, and toys

• High‑Speed Wi‑Fi + Dedicated Workspace
• Free Parking for Up to 5 Vehicles
• Single‑Level Layout

Easy accessibility throughout

• Preferred Wellness Perk
10% off private yoga sessions

BEDROOMS
Each bedroom is designed as a calm, comfortable retreat with quality mattresses, plush linens, ample storage, and natural light—ideal for restful nights after full Scottsdale days.

✹ Primary Bedroom – 1 Large king-sized bed, TV, closet, ensuite bathroom
✹ Second suite - Bedroom 2 – 1 Queen-sized bed, closet, ensuite bathroom
✹ Bedroom 3 – 1 full-sized bed, 1 twin, TV, closet
✹ Bedroom 4 - 2 full-sized beds, TV, closet
✹ Bedroom 5 – 2 full-sized beds, TV, closet
✹ Bedroom 6 – daybed with twin-sized comfortable mattress

✔Pack ‘n Play and highchair available for our young guests
✔Extra pillows and blankets

OUTDOOR LIVING
The backyard is the heart of the home—private, refined, and built for enjoyment.
• Heated pool option available
• Sun loungers with umbrellas
• Fire pit and grill
• Shaded lounge and dining areas
• Outdoor smart TV
• Iconic pyramid daybed

From sunrise yoga to evening cocktails, this space adapts seamlessly.

LOCATION
Perfectly positioned near Scottsdale’s most sought‑after experiences—from outdoor adventures to dining, nightlife, and wellness—while offering a quiet, residential setting to return to.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Entire home is private
• Starter essentials provided
• Washer/dryer with detergent
• Central A/C and heating
• No pets

An elevated Scottsdale escape designed for comfort, style, and ease.
We’re here to ensure a seamless stay from arrival to departure.

 Guest access 
During your stay, you will have exclusive access to the entire property, ensuring maximum privacy and convenience. The access to the home is through a keypad. 

Code will be provided 24 hours before arrival.

Check-In: Easy self-check-in is available via the keypad on the front door - a personalized code will be sent to you prior to check-in.

✹ Security Cameras: There is a camera in front of the entrance door and above the garage. No other cameras will be placed on the premises.

✹ Additional Properties: We offer a variety of properties in the area. Please let us know if you’re interested in booking any of the other properties for your group, and we will be happy to try and accommodate you.
amenities: Children’s books and toys for ages 0-2 years old, 2-5 years old, 5-10 years old, and 10+ years old
Coffee maker: drip coffee maker, french press, Keurig coffee machine
Pack ’n play/Travel crib - always at the listing
Standalone high chair - always at the listing
